primary: Per crop, any candidate centre within 25 m (50 patch pixels) of any inventory reference point. Same rule in both arms.
localizedSecondary: Primary, plus box area <=16000 patch pixels and maximum side <=200 patch pixels.
interpretation: Proximity diagnostic only; reference point accuracy, visible remains and feature boundaries are unverified. No accuracy/recall or confirmed discovery claim.
reviewBudget: 12 baseline x5 images +12 enriched x12 images =204 image inspections; fresh workers, at most three concurrent.
blinding: Fresh contexts; private key outside anonymous folders. File access restriction is procedural, not an OS sandbox. Reviewers not told sample composition.
freeze: Raw worker outputs must be hashed before key is joined; no reprompting based on control outcomes.
